Position Summary:
At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.
As a US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate, after successfully passing FPGEE and TOEFL, you will be eligible to complete your required US Internship hours and apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a mixed modality learning plan designed to further develop your knowledge, skills, and abilities. US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates are required to successfully complete their internship within 18 months and be prepared to complete and pass all required Pharmacist licensure exams and processes within 120-days of the completion of required US Internship hours.
Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), and time spent with leaders in your district, you will deepen your understanding of and participate in pharmacy practice and patient care scenarios, build business acumen to understand how to improve pharmacy performance, and develop leadership skills to learn how to engage the pharmacy team and drive business outcomes. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.
A US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:
Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients

Job Posting Title:
Corporate Social Responsibility Intern, Spring 2027
Req ID:
10156665
Job Description:
About the Role
“We make magic.” That’s our motto at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts. And it permeates everything we do. At Disney, you’ll help inspire that magic by enabling our teams to push the limits of entertainment and create the never-before-seen!
The Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) team is part of the Public Affairs division at Walt Disney World® Resort and collaborates with internal partners across the company to address the most critical needs in our communities. We create magic inside our parks by granting wishes to critically ill children and their families. We also extend the magic of Disney into our communities through volunteering and making significant financial and non-financial investments in causes that make a difference every day in the lives of those around us.
What You Will Do
Because no social responsibility issues are alike, you’ll gain experience working across multiple areas to create collaboration and add dimension to our initiatives, ultimately leading to lasting positive impacts in our communities. You’ll assist with project management, research and issue development, strategy and implementation, special events, and executing assigned tactics.
As a CSR Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to:
Assist with the identification and tracking of issues relevant to Walt Disney World through research and analysis.
Work with community nonprofits to better understand their challenges and barriers.
Support internal processes to help bridge gaps in community needs through unique Disney resources.
Work with internal and external partners to plan, support, and execute special events, Disney VoluntEARS, campaigns, and drives.
Tell the Disney CSR story in a creative, relevant way to strengthen our reputation and raise awareness of the causes we support.
Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism, ensuring compliance with company policies and data privacy regulations.
Additional project work as assigned by External Affairs leadership.
This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in Orlando, Florida, from January 2027 through June 2027.
Please Apply If You Are/Have
A zeal for making magic and helping to serve communities and inspire youth.
A self-motivated, creative thinker with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and execute with excellence.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills.
Able to work well with diverse groups, synthesizing various points of view that lead to consensus and influence decision-making.
Demonstrated computer proficiency in the Microsoft Office 365 and/or MAC OS environment.
It Would Also Be Great If You Have
Involvement in volunteering or supporting nonprofit causes.
Background or education in youth education programming.
Previous writing experience in a professional setting.
Understanding of emerging and current issues.
Strong creative skills with demonstrated ability to design and develop collateral and presentations.
Education
Junior or Senior year preferred
Pursuing a degree in Nonprofit Management, Education, Journalism, Communication, Marketing, Public Relations, Public Affairs, Public Administration, Political Science, or a related major.
Eligibility Requirements & Program Information
Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all the requirements below
Be enrolled in an accredited college/university, pursuing a degree, taking at least one class at the time of application, OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.
Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney Internship or Disney College Program.
Be at least 18 years of age.
Possess unrestricted work authorization.
Additional Information
The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 through June 2027.
Fully available from Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time Zone, with possible weekends or shifts that are outside of these hours for the duration of the internship, 40 hours each week.
Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the Orlando, Florida area.
Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work.
Be aligned with The Disney Look appearance guidelines.

About the Role & Program:
ABC11-WTVD is launching a newly combined Community Engagement and Marketing internship for Spring 2027, designed for students who want to understand how a local television station connects with audiences beyond the broadcast through community partnerships, digital storytelling, and strategic marketing initiatives.
This role sits at the intersection of two functions that increasingly work together to strengthen the station's relationship with the communities it serves. The Marketing Department serves as the station’s internal advertising agency, with News as its primary client, promoting content and the ABC11 brand across multiple platforms. The Community Engagement Department collaborates with community organizations and leaders to highlight and address local needs, priorities, and events.
This is an ideal opportunity for a student interested in communications, marketing, digital media, public relations, or community engagement who wants to see how audience growth and community impact work together in a modern media organization.
This internship is a part-time, six-month commitment in Durham, NC from January 2027 – June 2027.
What You Will Do:
On any given day you might cover the following for the departments:
Community Engagement:

Job Description Summary
Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.
Job Description
Help invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely as a GE Aerospace Edison Works intern or co-op! At GE Aerospace, safety and quality are our top priorities — and in Edison Works, you’ll apply them while working at the forefront of advanced aerospace innovation. As part of this team, you’ll take on challenging, real-world engineering problems focused on developing next-generation propulsion technologies for critical military applications. You’ll build professional and technical skills through hands-on experience, mentorship, and training, while forming connections with fellow interns, engineers, and leaders. This experience will help prepare you for a potential full-time career at GE Aerospace, whether through one of our leadership programs or direct-hire opportunities.
In Advanced Programs Aero Design, you will contribute to the invention and development of next-generation military propulsion systems by defining and delivering integrated aero solutions that support national defense and future mission needs. You’ll work on advanced aero concepts for augmentors and exhaust nozzles, helping mature innovative designs that meet demanding customer capability requirements. As an Edison Works Aero Engineer, you’ll gain experience creating "air solid" CAD models in NX, generating meshes in Ansys Workbench, and performing analysis and post-processing using Ansys CFX and Fluent for non/reacting and reacting combustion flows. You’ll also collaborate across a highly integrated team of mechanical, thermal, performance, and survivability engineers to develop optimized solutions for some of the most advanced propulsion challenges in the industry.

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.
Internship Overview
The Home Depot’s Summer Internship program offers college students an opportunity to develop leadership skills and gain hands on experience in a corporate environment. During an 11 – week period from May 17 - July 30, 2027, interns will be assigned to a functional team such as Supply Chain, Marketing, e-commerce, Technology, Finance, Operations, Merchandising, Pro, Home Services, Human Resources, etc. Interns will learn more about our retail business and our corporate offices while having the opportunity to work on a pre-assigned project that impacts the function they are supporting. Additionally, interns participate in networking and development activities that set them up for success as they build their careers.
What makes a Great Intern:
Action Oriented: Intern takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
Manages Ambiguity: Intern effectively navigates and thrives in uncertain situations while using sound judgment to make decisions without having the full picture. Is able to move work forward without all the details
Collaboration: Intern contributes to the group’s efforts and steps forward to help as needed. Seeks input from others
Nimble Learning: Intern actively learns through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder
Communication: Intern develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audience
Customer Focus: Intern builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions
Drives Results: Evaluates information to make logical decisions and achieve results despite potential challenges or setbacks.
Product Management Intern:
The Product Management Intern works hand in hand, and is often paired with, the other members of a product team (PM, UX, Engineering) to find the fastest way to achieve value around business needs. The role focuses on assessing customer needs and performing qualitative and quantitative research to discover feature ideas and validate them for a designated product. The Product Management Intern should aim to deliver business value to drive sales, improve efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction through the creation of quality products. The Product Manager Intern will work closely with more experienced Product Managers to gain proficiency in value creation, prioritization, defining MVP, user story construction, and overall product management. The focus of our Product internship is on learning day-to-day operations and obtaining an overall comprehension of business for The Home Depot.
Tasks, responsibilities, and key accountabilities include:
Strategy & Planning:
Listens to and knows the customers of the product; gains understanding of customer needs to help determine minimum viable product (MVP) as well as future needs
Translates business goals and end user needs into product strategy; communicates direction and product priorities to the development team, other matrixed teams, and third-party partners
Identifies goals, metrics, and analytics to determine product value; continually make recommendations and refinements to the product backlog based on learnings
Manages and grooms the product backlog; makes future decisions based on the value that will be delivered
Partners with Finance to understand financial needs and assists in the creation of business plans for new opportunities
Monitors research as well as the competitive landscape to recommend the best solutions and ensure that products remain or become best in class
Ensures that product directions balance both the user needs and business goals of driving sales, improving efficiency and enhancing customer satisfaction
Delivery and Execution:
Formulates, tests and refines assumptions and hypotheses through user research and testing
Creates, prioritizes, and accepts user stories; incorporates them into release planning
Makes product decisions that drive value on a daily basis
Identifies and considers pros, cons, issues, obstacles, dependencies, and value associated with features and enhancements
Participates in standups, iteration planning sessions, product demos, and retrospectives
Condenses complex technical concepts into non-technical language for stakeholders
People:
Fosters collaboration with team members (Engineering, UX, etc.) to drive value and identify and resolve impediments
Acts as a coach and proponent of modern software development principles
Advocates for the end user and stakeholder by becoming a domain expert, empathizing with and understanding user needs
Works with the product team to continuously assess progress, disseminate lessons learned, and understand next steps
Manages cross functional team and stakeholder expectations to execute on product strategy, provides education to requestors to determine prioritization based on tangible benefits and/or user experience
Participates in and contributes to learning activities around modern software design and development core practices (communities of practice)
Preferred Qualifications
Currently pursuing a relevant degree
0-1 years of relevant work experience
Exposure to modern software development product management practices and agile methodologies, specifically the extreme programming (XP) principles of paired programming, test driven development, and continuous deployment
Experience working in a fast paced, fluid environment where priorities shift on a regular basis
Experience communicating with and influencing functional and technical team members at all levels in the organization
Interest in working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional, modern software design and development team
Exposure to creating, prioritizing, and accepting user stories
Experience conducting user research and testing to understand needs
Exposure to identifying goals, metrics, and analytics to measure product value
Preferred GPA 3.0 or above
Description of Roles: (Career paths that utilize this skillset full-time)
At The Home Depot, our associates always have room to move up and explore new opportunities. After the Internship, here are some examples of early career roles for interns with a background in Product Management:
Associate Product Manager Program (Rotational)
Product Manager
Location: Interns will be expected to work in-person at the Atlanta Corporate Office (Store Support Center) five days a week (Monday-Friday). Housing assistance will be provided to eligible interns.

Job Description:
Job Title: Retail Pharmacy Intern
Department: Pharmacy
FLSA: Hourly
Revision Date: 07/2026
About Hy-Vee
At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.
The Role and Why It's Important
Our Retail Pharmacy Interns gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced retail pharmacy setting while working toward their pharmacy degree. In this role, you'll fill prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist, assist with inventory and quality assurance, and help deliver the exceptional patient care that Hy-Vee is known for.
If you are an enrolled pharmacy student who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and passionate about patient health, we'd love to have you on our team.
What You'll Do
No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:
Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile and making every interaction a positive one
Fill and help process prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist in accordance with all state and federal statutes and regulations
Prepare prescriptions and affix labels to prescription containers
Report any medication errors to appropriate personnel
Assist with inventory control including ordering, stocking merchandise, checking invoices, and entering inventory information
Assist with monthly inventory and follow security and regulatory procedures including Quality Assurance Programs
Assist in training pharmacy employees
Maintain the cleanliness of the pharmacy and dispensing area
Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information and prescription drug pricing in accordance with HIPAA
Work with co-workers as a team to ensure strict adherence to standard operating procedures and facility policies
Maintain a professional appearance at all times
Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned
Adhere to all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines
Report to work when scheduled and on time
Your Skills
Apply logical and scientific thinking to solve problems involving both abstract and concrete variables
Perform arithmetic, algebraic, and geometric calculations accurately
Compose original correspondence, follow technical manuals, and evaluate technical data
Counsel and advise customers and interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and team members
Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient and financial information
Reporting Relationships
Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Pharmacy Department Manager
Education and Experience
Currently enrolled in an accredited college of pharmacy required
Registered with the State Pharmacy Board as an intern required
Six months or less of similar or related work experience preferred
Physical Requirements
Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions
Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations
Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration
Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties
Working Environment
This is a fast-paced role in a retail pharmacy where you will handle multiple tasks throughout your shift including filling prescriptions, answering the telephone, and assisting customers. You will have frequent exposure to noise and occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.
Are you ready to smile, apply today.
Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

In this role, you'll fill prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist, assist with inventory and quality assurance, and help deliver the exceptional patient care that Hy-Vee is known for.
If you are an enrolled pharmacy student who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and passionate about patient health, we'd love to have you on our team.
What You'll Do
No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:
Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile and making every interaction a positive one
Fill and help process prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist in accordance with all state and federal statutes and regulations
Prepare prescriptions and affix labels to prescription containers
Report any medication errors to appropriate personnel
Assist with inventory control including ordering, stocking merchandise, checking invoices, and entering inventory information
Assist with monthly inventory and follow security and regulatory procedures including Quality Assurance Programs
Assist in training pharmacy employees
Maintain the cleanliness of the pharmacy and dispensing area
Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information and prescription drug pricing in accordance with HIPAA
Work with co-workers as a team to ensure strict adherence to standard operating procedures and facility policies
Maintain a professional appearance at all times
Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned
Adhere to all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines
Report to work when scheduled and on time
Your Skills
Apply logical and scientific thinking to solve problems involving both abstract and concrete variables
Perform arithmetic, algebraic, and geometric calculations accurately
Compose original correspondence, follow technical manuals, and evaluate technical data
Counsel and advise customers and interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and team members
Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient and financial information
Reporting Relationships
Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Pharmacy Department Manager
Education and Experience
Currently enrolled in an accredited college of pharmacy required
Registered with the State Pharmacy Board as an intern required
Six months or less of similar or related work experience preferred
Physical Requirements
Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions
Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations
Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration
Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties
Working Environment
This is a fast-paced role in a retail pharmacy where you will handle multiple tasks throughout your shift including filling prescriptions, answering the telephone, and assisting customers. You will have frequent exposure to noise and occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.
Are you ready to smile, apply today.
Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

As an AI Engineer Intern, you will join our innovative AI research and development team to work on cutting-edge, impactful real-world AI challenges.  You will collaborate with experienced AI researchers, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to design, develop, and implement advanced machine learning models, including large language models to deliver scalable and transformative AI-driven solutions. This internship offers the chance to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world, high-impact AI projects and receive hands-on technical mentorship and career development support from industry-leading experts.
This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work will be hybrid (minimum 2x per week) from our Reston, VA office. Pay is expected to be $32 per hour. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position.    
What you will do: 
Contribute to the AI lifecycle:  
Support the end-to end AI product development process, encompassing data acquisition, preprocessing, model design, training, optimization, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation to ensure scalable and robust solutions.  
Assist in all phases of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, preprocessing, model development, optimization, deployment, and evaluation. 
Develop machine learning models:  
Design, develop, and train advanced machine learning models, including deep learning and large-scale models, to address complex challenges in domains like natural language processing (NLP) and Generative AI.  
Build and train machine learning models, including deep learning models, to solve complex challenges in areas such as natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI. 
Analyze large datasets:  
Conduct exploratory data analysis and advanced feature engineering on large-scale, semi-structured datasets to uncover actionable insights and enhance model accuracy and efficiency.  
Perform data analysis and feature engineering on massive, semi-structured datasets to extract meaningful insights and improve model performance. 
Engineer robust software:  
Develop high-quality, production-ready code in languages such as Python, Java, C++, R, JavaScript, along with a good understanding of common AI development frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit-learn while actively participating in system design discussions, code reviews, and testing to ensure robust and maintainable software.  
Write clean, production-level code in languages like Python and C++, and participate in design sessions and code reviews to ensure software quality. 
Research emerging technologies:  
Research and prototype cutting-edge AI and machine learning methodologies, including advancements in areas like explainable AI, federated learning, or multimodal models, while keeping abreast of the latest research and industry trends.  
Help research and prototype new AI and machine learning techniques, staying up-to-date on the latest advancements in the field. 
Collaborate across teams:  
Partner with cross-functional teams, including product or project managers, data engineers and scientists, and software engineers to refine project requirements, align on objectives, and deliver innovative, high-impact AI-driven solutions.  
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers and other engineers, to define project requirements and deliver high-quality technology products. 
Basic Qualifications 
A minimum of 9 credit hours of completed graduate-level courses in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. 
A completed bachelor's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. 
Candidate must be a US citizen, reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S. per contract requirements

A strong foundation in core computer science concepts, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis. 
Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, with a strong preference for Python. 
Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn. 
Demonstrated experience with large-scale datasets and data preprocessing. 
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
Experience with version control systems like Git is a plus.

Mentorship: You will be paired with a dedicated mentor to support your growth and development throughout the internship. 
Hands-on experience: Gain valuable, practical experience working on impactful, real-world AI projects. 
Learning opportunities: Access training resources and workshops to enhance your technical and professional skills.

We are seeking a motivated and curious 2027 Summer Intern, Cloud Engineer (AWS / Azure) to join our team and support cloud DevOps, governance, and security compliance work across AWS and Azure environments. This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work will be hybrid from Reston, VA. Pay is expected to be $27 per hour for undergraduate interns and $32 per hour for graduate interns. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position.

You'll rotate across the team's core areas of work, with specific projects assigned based on team priorities at the time:
Cloud DevOps & Automation: Support infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD automation used to build and maintain cloud environments. Help write, test, and document automation that provisions and manages resources across AWS and Azure.
Cloud Governance: Assist in the administration and governance of AWS and Azure organizations, including account/subscription structure, identity and access management (IAM), and policy-based guardrails that keep environments consistent and compliant.
Security & ATO Compliance: Contribute to security tooling and compliance efforts that support Authorization to Operate (ATO), including work aligned to security control baselines (such as NIST 800-53), vulnerability and posture management, and evidence/documentation for audits.

Productivity-as-code - capturing repeatable work as reusable prompts, workflows, agents, and automation so that effort compounds into leverage for the whole team rather than one-off tasks.
Collaborate with engineers on cloud-native products and services, and participate in team meetings, code reviews, and documentation efforts.

Governance: organization-level policy and guardrail management, identity and access management

AI-enabled engineering: AI-enabled IDEs and coding assistants, spec-driven development, and productivity-as-code practices, applied with appropriate review and governance

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure).

Basic understanding of networking, IAM, and cloud security principles.
Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD concepts is a plus.
Interest in cloud compliance, governance, or security (ATO/RMF, NIST) is a plus.
Experience using AI tools (such as AI coding assistants or chat assistants) to support technical or analytical work is a plus.
Enthusiasm for learning and applying new technologies.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Work on impactful cloud DevOps, governance, and security projects in a supportive, learning-focused environment.

Discover Your Future with Inmar Intelligence: Where Potential Meets Purpose
For more than 45 years, Inmar Intelligence has helped some of the world’s leading brands, retailers, and healthcare organizations solve complex challenges through data, technology, and innovation. Our work has a meaningful impact on everyday life — from helping consumers save money to making healthcare safer and more efficient and helping businesses operate smarter.
Behind that work are people who are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make things better. At Inmar, our High Challenge, High Support culture creates an environment where people are encouraged to stretch their thinking, take on meaningful challenges, and grow — with the support and partnership to succeed.
Where Potential Meets Purpose comes to life through the opportunities our interns have to learn, contribute, and grow. You bring your curiosity, perspective, and what you’ve learned so far. We give you opportunities to put that potential to work on real business challenges, contribute to projects that matter, and learn alongside experienced professionals invested in your growth.
At Inmar, we believe in:
Raising the Bar in everything we do
Seeking Truth Together through collaboration and learning
Putting our Customer First
Your internship is a chance to explore what you’re capable of, build skills through real experience, and begin shaping what comes next.
About This Opportunity
Inmar’s Summer Internship Program offers a dynamic experience designed to give students real-world exposure to a professional environment while contributing meaningfully to company initiatives. Interns split their time between a high-impact cross-functional team project and department-specific responsibilities assigned by their direct manager.
Our Business & Operations Internship opportunities give students hands-on experience solving business challenges through analysis, research, process improvement, project support, and cross-functional collaboration. Depending on business needs, opportunities may be available across areas such as Corporate Operations, Global Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain, Process Improvement, Regulatory & Compliance Operations, Sustainability, and other business functions.
As a Business & Operations intern, you may analyze data, evaluate processes, conduct research, support projects, develop reports or presentations, and help teams identify opportunities to work more effectively. While the subject matter may vary by assignment, these opportunities share a common goal: using information, critical thinking, and collaboration to turn business challenges into practical solutions.
You’ll work alongside experienced professionals and gain exposure to how different teams across Inmar operate, make decisions, manage priorities, and continuously improve the way work gets done.
Please note: These internship opportunities are expected to be based onsite at our Winston-Salem, NC location and will require in-person attendance during the summer. This posting is intended to build our candidate pipeline for anticipated Summer 2027 Business & Operations internship opportunities. Specific internship assignments, responsibilities, and team placement will be based on business needs and determined as opportunities are finalized.
What You May Do
Depending on your internship assignment, you may:
Analyze business, operational, supplier, compliance, or performance data to identify trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities.
Evaluate existing processes and help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, consistency, or effectiveness.
Conduct research and benchmarking to support business recommendations, operational decisions, or strategic initiatives.
Help gather, organize, validate, and maintain information used for reporting, decision-making, or operational processes.
Support process improvement initiatives by documenting current-state workflows, identifying potential root causes, and helping evaluate or implement solutions.
Develop or enhance reports, dashboards, presentations, documentation, and other tools that help teams understand performance and communicate findings.
Assist with project planning, coordination, documentation, and follow-through on business initiatives.
Support the development or improvement of processes, procedures, standards, and internal resources.
Prepare and communicate findings, recommendations, and project updates to managers and cross-functional partners.
Collaborate with teams across Inmar to understand business needs and contribute to solutions that improve operations and support company objectives.
What You’ll Gain
Hands-on experience applying analysis, research, problem-solving, and project management skills to real business challenges.
Exposure to how organizations evaluate processes, use data, and make operational decisions.
Opportunities to develop skills in process improvement, data analysis, business research, reporting, and presentation.
Experience translating information and analysis into clear findings and actionable recommendations.
Exposure to cross-functional projects and how different business areas work together to achieve shared goals.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced business and operations professionals.
A better understanding of potential career paths across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Process Improvement, Compliance, Sustainability, Project Management, and related business functions.
Your Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Economics, Management, or a related field.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills with curiosity about how businesses and processes work.
Comfort working with data and using information to identify patterns, answer questions, or support recommendations.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
Proficiency with productivity tools such as Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, along with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize information and present findings to others.
Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with peers, managers, and cross-functional partners.
Adaptability and a willingness to learn new tools, processes, industries, and subject matter.
Eagerness to take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and contribute in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Depending on the Assignment, Preferred Skills May Include
Coursework or experience in operations, supply chain, procurement, project management, process improvement, business analytics, compliance, or sustainability.
Experience analyzing data and developing reports, dashboards, or presentations.
Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, root cause analysis, 5 Whys, or process mapping.
Experience with advanced Excel or Google Sheets functionality, data visualization, or reporting tools.
Familiarity with CRM, procurement, supply chain, project management, or other enterprise systems.
Experience conducting market, industry, supplier, regulatory, or competitive research.
Exposure to warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or other operational environments.
Interest in using AI, automation, and emerging tools to improve research, analysis, processes, or productivity.
Why Intern at Inmar Intelligence
Your summer at Inmar is about putting what you’ve learned into practice while continuing to discover where your interests and strengths can take you. You’ll contribute to real-world projects, work alongside experienced professionals, and see how data, technology, automation, and innovation are shaping the future of business.
Beyond your day-to-day work, you’ll build connections through mentorship, cross-functional networking, and collaboration with fellow interns, with learning and development opportunities designed to support your growth. You’ll gain experience you can carry forward while exploring potential career paths and building relationships across Inmar.
You’ll also be part of an environment where different perspectives are valued, ideas are encouraged, and community impact matters — giving you the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to something bigger than your individual assignment.
Bring your potential. Find your purpose. Discover your future at Inmar.

Exposure to advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies and processes.

Mentorship from experienced engineers and technical leaders.
Development of technical, analytical, and professional skills in a fast-paced engineering environment.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with teams across commercial, logistics, and customer service functions, and play a critical role in process improvement, strategic analytics, and project leadership.
As a Johnson & Johnson Co-Op you will also have opportunities to build a community with other Co-Ops through events, trainings, networking, and community outreach.
Core Responsibilities:
Identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements using advanced Excel skills. Lead at least one high-impact project utilizing LEAN/Six Sigma methodologies to optimize pharmaceutical processes.
Manage relationships with targeted customers and/or internal partners, ensuring operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Develop, implement, and monitor supply chain initiatives to enhance the end-to-end customer experience.
Generate detailed reports and dashboards to inform decision-making, including weekly pharmaceutical supply chain reports, ad hoc analytics, and KPI tracking using Excel and visualization tools such as Power BI.
Collaborate with internal teams on business process improvements and projects aligned with strategic objectives for 2026.
Facilitate proactive communication by distributing reports, leading meetings, and supporting local team activities as needed.
Qualifications:
Education: Currently pursuing a BA/BS in Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Business, or related fields.
Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel (V-Lookups, Pivot Tables, Formulas, Macros), PowerPoint, Word.
Familiarity with supply chain management systems (SAP preferred).
Experience with Data Analytics and Visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic mindset.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Creative thinker with a development-focused attitude and ability to quickly adapt to new systems.
Proven leadership or project management experience (preferred).
Previous co-op or internship experience is a plus.

We are currently seeking a Summer 2027 Intern in Public Institutions Advisory to join our team. In this role, you will learn real estate valuation methodologies, strategic advisory for public sector clients, and comprehensive market analysis techniques.
As a Summer Intern in Public Institutions at JLL, you will:
• Analyze complex real estate portfolios: Evaluate development opportunities, asset portfolios, and operations for public institutions to determine highest and best use, market values, and advise on strategic initiatives
• Develop financial models and valuations: Use valuation methodologies, research, and identify risks, understand key industry dynamics and underwriting metrics, and prepare corresponding financial models to support JLL team members and client outcomes
• Conduct market and demographic research: Analyze market data and comparable transactions; conduct detailed economic and demographic research through the use of JLL and third-party information services to due diligence and determine feasibility of real estate strategies
• Communicate findings and recommendations: Effectively communicate – written and presentation – results of analysis to internal team members and clients; participate in client engagement activities
• Support business development and operations: Support business development through client proposals, pitches, and relationships; monitor and update Salesforce to track client leads and opportunities; assist in organizing team meetings, maintaining project databases, and enhancing overall team operations

• Dates: Summer 2027
• Location: San Diego, CA – Austin, TX - Washinton, DC. - or Chicago, IL

• Actively pursuing a bachelor's degree, with 2-3 years completed majoring in finance, real estate, economics, business, or related field
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with attention to detail
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to present complex information clearly
• Interest in commercial real estate and public sector advisory
• Ability to manage multiple projects and work collaboratively in a team environment

A strong interest in pursuing a career path as a commissioned Broker.

Greenhill’s Houston based Investment Banking group is seeking an Investment Banking Associate 1 to join their expanding team. This group has a strong focus in Upstream, Midstream, Energy Transition and primarily focuses on M&A transactions.
Greenhill Investment Banking Associates are directly involved in the design, origination, structuring and execution of mergers & acquisitions, including both buy-side, sell-side and other strategic advisory mandates for existing and prospective clients. An Associate is expected to understand the implications, identify key industry and product trends and provide input on pitch and deal materials to enhance the ultimate deliverable to our clients.
Associates are assigned to a variety of projects and are given a broad range of responsibilities, some of which include:
Conduct extensive quantitative economic, industry and company research and analysis
Draft and prepare pitch books with detailed industry materials
Conduct and model a broad range of corporate finance alternatives and due diligence for client transactions including buy-side M&A, sell-side M&A and other strategic advisory mandates
Financial modelling, valuation, comparable & relative value analyses and market-specific analyses including building discounted cash flow, comparable companies, precedent transactions, leveraged buyout and merger combination models
Facilitate and coordinate idea generation and solutions development with relevant groups across Mizuho | Greenhill
Develop and prepare client presentations and materials with a focus on quality, accuracy and timeliness
Assist in the evaluation, preparation, due diligence and execution of M&A transactions
Assist in the development and continued cultivation of client relationships
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in finance or economics and a minimum of 3 years investment banking, corporate finance, and M&A experience with a top tier Investment Bank OR an MBA concentrating on Finance or Economics
Knowledge of corporate finance, securities, financial markets and risk & pricing analysis
Experience in Energy industry a strong plus
Aptitude to synthesize large amounts of information and develop innovative ideas and/or product solutions
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Maturity and good judgement in handling confidential and sensitive information
Ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to convey ideas
Creativity and intellectual curiosity
Ability to work independently and must be able to work effectively in a team environment

Marathon Petroleum Company LP (MPC) offers internship and co-op opportunities to high-performing college students who want meaningful hands-on experiences in their fields of study. The Intern will be responsible for scheduling the delivery of light products, feedstocks, and biofuels by pipeline or waterborne transportation to third party and company locations to meet customer’s demand (sales forecast). The intern will coordinate pipeline, barge and/or tanker movements for appropriate timing, batch size and sequence of product shipments to optimize the supply of the available products from refineries and terminals, while also minimizing transportation costs and ensuring quality. Additionally, they will develop improved scheduling methods to efficiently utilize company resources, optimize inventory levels, and minimize transportation costs as well as coordinate the communications between terminals, Commercial, Exchange and Product Quality regarding any inventory or operational issue.

ABOUT POET
At POET, it is our mission to be good stewards of the Earth by converting renewable resources to energy and other valuable goods as effectively as humanly possible. For over thirty-five years, our drive and passion to change the world has enabled us to become the largest producer and marketer of bioethanol and a leader in sustainable products in the world.
CULTURE IS KING AT POET
We’re all on the same team. We always communicate. And we park our egos at the door. These aren’t just slogans on our walls. It’s the way we do things at POET. We provide an environment for team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance. It’s the best way to optimize health, wellness, and productivity in a sustainable way. We work hard. We play hard. We have frequent team events, volunteer efforts, and we know how to celebrate wins!
JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES
Each day, our team at POET Bioproducts markets and transports 20,000 tons of our high-quality products to our thousands of customers who are located all over the globe. As the Credit Analyst Intern, you will help with the success of these sales by validating credit information for our customers while understanding agriculture markets and risks associated with the market. This role will also assist in maintaining accurate account information, finding solutions for customers’ inquiries, and supporting POET Merchandisers to provide creative and safe solutions for credit needs within the guidelines of POET’s Credit Policy.

Assist in review and analysis of credit applications to make recommendations for establishing appropriate lines of credit.
Assist in analyzing financial statements and 3rd party report review (business credit reports, bank and trade references).
Analyze commodity markets and profitability metrics for producers to identify customer risk.
Utilize analytical skillset to identify credit risks (metrics like DSO, past due reporting, etc.).
Provide multiple credit/payment options to the commercial team based on the facts and circumstances of each transaction.
Ensure professional relationships are established and maintained with both internal and external customers.
Work closely with Merchandising and Transportation team members to respond to credit and collection concerns with existing and potential customers.
Since we’re all about teamwork and getting the job done, your skill may be put to a lot of other uses!

Sophomore or Junior level student working towards a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or business
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with an interest in data analysis and the ability to learn new programs.
A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE
A customer service mindset and a desire to find solutions
Excellent communication skills and attention to detail
Excellent organization and time management skills with a sense of urgency that drives results
A high level of personal integrity
Interpersonal skills – the ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels within/outside the organization
Demonstrated problem-solving and critical thinking skills
The ability to embrace and promote change
An innovative mindset and the ability to think objectively
Self-awareness and creativity in the face of uncertainty
The ability to work individually and in a team environment
WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position operates in an office environment, working at a personal computer where you may sit or stand. Most of our Sioux Falls office workspace consists of an open-concept design intended to promote open communication and collaboration.
GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES
At POET, we encourage internal development and growth by allowing team members to carve their own path to success. Leaders support team members with the necessary resources to develop their skills, achieve goals, and create the most value. We believe in developing our team members to their highest potential and recognizing contributions that add value to the organization. Each new team member’s position and compensation are carefully determined by considering their unique qualifications and skillset.

Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, is the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences across Neiman Marcus, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Job Description:
YOU WILL BE:
The Manager, Co-op & Brand Partner Marketing owns and grows a portfolio of strategic brand partnerships, serving as a trusted advisor to brand partners and a key commercial partner to ELG’s internal teams. Reporting to the Director, Co-op & Brand Partner Marketing, this role translates brand priorities, category insights and ELG business objectives into integrated marketing programs that drive partner investment, deliver measurable results and create value for both the partner and ELG.
The Manager leads the partnership lifecycle, from account planning and opportunity development through investment negotiation, cross-functional execution, performance measurement and future growth planning. Success requires strong commercial judgment, relationship-building skills, data-driven decision making and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization. This individual must be comfortable presenting recommendations, navigating complex business conversations and representing ELG credibly with senior brand partners and internal leaders. v
WHAT YOU WILL DO:
Own day-to-day relationships and seasonal planning for an assigned portfolio of managed brand partners; build trust, understand each brand’s priorities, category performance, investment history and decision process, and serve as a strategic thought partner.
Build account plans and identify revenue opportunities across print, digital, onsite and offsite media, store experiences, events and other ELG marketing assets as appropriate.
Develop and present thoughtful proposals, investment recommendations and business cases that connect brand goals, customer insight, commercial priorities, available inventory and measurable outcomes.
Translate brand priorities into distinctive, integrated programs that deliver customer and commercial value to ELG while strengthening the long-term partnership.
Lead partner meetings and negotiate scope, investment and deliverables with tact and clarity; manage difficult conversations and escalate material commercial or relationship risks to the Director.
Present confidently to brand executives, agencies and internal leaders, representing ELG’s business, marketing capabilities and partnership point of view with credibility and sound judgment.
Partner with merchants and internal business leaders to understand assortment, receipts, category trends and seasonal priorities, and translate those insights into relevant brand opportunities.
Lead cross-functional stakeholder management across Creative, CRM, Social, Events, Store Marketing, Digital, Retail Media, Analytics, Finance, Merchandising and Partnership Operations; establish shared objectives, clarify roles, navigate competing priorities and keep decisions and deliverables moving.
Partner closely with Retail Media and agency teams to incorporate onsite and offsite media, sponsored products and relevant audience solutions into broader brand plans; align on strategy, investment, execution requirements, measurement and partner communication.
Maintain accurate pipeline, proposal, commitment and forecast records; track co-op revenue, partner investment and fulfillment against the assigned portfolio’s goals.
Review campaign and business performance, develop timely recaps, and use the results to recommend optimizations and future investment; communicate both progress and limitations clearly to partners.
Stay informed about ELG’s business, customer experience, marketing calendar and the competitive luxury and retail media landscape to represent the company credibly in partner meetings.
Contribute partner feedback, category ideas and practical process improvements to the Director’s broader co-op strategy and partnership offering.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING:
Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):
5+ years of experience in brand partnerships, account management, marketing, retail media or a related commercial role.
Demonstrated success managing partner relationships, developing account growth strategies and identifying opportunities to increase revenue or marketing investment.
Strong presentation, written communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to navigate sensitive commercial conversations and build productive relationships with senior stakeholders.
Experience developing proposals and translating business, customer, sales or campaign data into actionable recommendations and compelling partner-facing presentations.
Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities and drive projects forward without direct reporting authority.
Experience managing multiple accounts, projects or integrated marketing programs from planning through execution, measurement and recap.
Working knowledge of digital media and omnichannel marketing, with an understanding of how marketing investments support brand and business objectives.
Preferred Qualifications (nice to haves):
Experience with luxury, fashion, beauty or multi-banner retail
Understanding of media or retail media, campaign measurement and e-commerce analytics; experience collaborating with or managing media agencies is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or equivalent practical experience.

Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
An amazing employee discount

Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! As a Aerospace Engineering Intern, you will participate in a comprehensive summer internship program designed to provide hands-on experience in a dynamic aerospace and defense environment. You will work alongside industry experts, contribute to real-world projects, and develop valuable technical and professional skills. This internship offers a unique opportunity for growth through mentoring, cross-functional workshops, and direct involvement in company projects.
The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries.
Responsibilities:
Participate in actual technical projects and contribute to team objectives by completing assigned tasks.
Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced industry professionals in your field.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, reports, and records as required.
Assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to support engineering decisions.
Attend planning meetings to understand project requirements, timelines, and team goals.
Perform hands-on technical work assignments to gain practical experience and build technical skills.
Work closely with team members, absorb and learn from their expertise, and apply that learning to ongoing projects.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and support the implementation of best practices.
Participate in workshops designed to provide a deeper understanding of the business and company culture.
Qualifications You Must Have:
Must be a Sophomore, Junior, or Senior in college or technical school, with at least 6 months until graduation after end of internship.
Currently enrolled in a university or college program pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio.
Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment.
Strong organization skills and work ethic; detail oriented.
The ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required
Qualifications We Prefer:
Prior internship or work experience in a technical or engineering role.
Familiarity with the Aerospace and Defense industry.
Basic knowledge of engineering software tools (e.g., CAD, MATLAB).
Microsoft Access skills.
Pursuing a degree in engineering or a related discipline.
Essential Functions:
Ability to sit at a computer for extended periods.
Proficiency with computers and office equipment.
Manual dexterity for handling tools and technical equipment.
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally.
Ability to work in a laboratory or workshop environment, which may involve exposure to loud noise levels or hazardous conditions.
Ability to travel may be required.
This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.
Estimated Starting Salary Range: $18.13 - $31.72. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors, such as candidates' key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.
SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more.
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Sony AI is Sony’s new research organization pursuing the mission to use AI to unleash human creativity. Sony AI works closely with Sony’s other business units, including Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC., Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc., and Sony Music Entertainment. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: https://ai.sony/
Research Intern – Self-evolving Multimodal Foundation Models
Sony is seeking research interns to join us. Our team mainly focuses on fundamental and applied research, with a focus on building next-generation foundation models for vision in a responsible manner. The role of a research intern is to develop efficient and effective methodologies and prototype solutions. You will work with a productive team of world-class scientists and engineers to tackle the most challenging problems in foundation models, including self-evolving vision foundation models (VFM), vision-language models (VLM), unified models, content management, automatic model optimization and deployement on cloud and edge. You will see your ideas not only published in papers, but also improve the experience of billions of customers.
Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct fundamental and innovative development in low-cost yet powerful foundation models, automatic model optimization and deployement on cloud and edge.
Collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams to translate research into practical solutions, leveraging foundation models, RSI and agentic approaches where appropriate.
Contribute to library and tool development to support business; or Publish influential research in top-tier conferences and journals.
Required Qualifications and Skills
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a master/PhD degree in computer science or related field.
Be very self-motivated and capable of proposing and implementing innovative ideas.
Solid presentation and communication skills to internal and external audiences.
Publications or expertise in compact foundation model development and deployment. Influential open-source projects or paper publication at top conferences, e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, etc.
Better to have front-end development experience.
Solid coding skills in Python, Pytorch, etc.
The target hourly rate for this internship is $50.00 per hour. The individual will be paid hourly and eligible for overtime.

The legal intern will work under the supervision of CLS attorneys on specific projects to provide legal and factual research and analysis to support clients’ applications for Asylum, Special Immigrant Juvenile Status (SIJS), and other humanitarian forms of relief such as T and U visa applications for survivors of human trafficking and other serious crimes. The legal intern will have an opportunity to assist attorneys in preparing for immigration court hearings and/or state court custody/guardianship proceedings relevant to Special Immigrant Juvenile Status. In addition, the legal intern will have direct client interactions to support clients with initial screenings, follow-up meetings, drafting their declarations, gathering and preparing other evidence relevant to their immigration applications. The intern will perform clerical and administrative duties to ensure client notes are current and files are organized and kept up to date.

Factual, Legal Research and Analysis. Intern will engage in fact-finding including country conditions factual research, legal research and analysis of client cases.

Draft immigration applications and legal cover letters/briefs and court motions.
Assist staff with monitoring status of clients’ immigration court removal proceedings
Record client notes in case management system and assist legal staff with sorting, scanning and filing documents in case files.
Adhere to IRC policies, particularly those related to confidentiality and client privacy. 
Display sensitivity to cultural and personality differences of clients.  Respect their beliefs and values. 
Other related duties as assigned.

Intern will learn about U.S. immigration law in the context of unaccompanied minors and youth.

Your Impact
The Vertex Business Process Excellence, HR Transformation Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an advanced degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Process Management or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our Business Process Excellence, HR Transformation functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

What you will be doing:
The Business Process Excellence team at Vertex is focused on improving how HR delivers services to employees, managers and candidates through process redesign, technology enablement and continuous improvement. he Business Process Excellence, HR Transformation Co-op will support the launch and continuous improvement of redesigned HR services. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in HR transformation, operational excellence, value realization and the use of AI tools in everyday work.

Performance Tracking & Reporting Learn the pre-launch baseline and business case goals, including turnaround times, hours saved and cost savings.
Gather and analyze process data and stakeholder feedback to track results against goals.
Prepare weekly progress reports for the team and HR leaders.
Continuous Improvement Maintain a prioritized backlog of process issues, improvement ideas and agreed actions, each with an owner and due date.
Follow up on open actions through completion and flag items that are stuck.
Lead working sessions with stakeholders to resolve assigned issues.
Measure whether improvements are delivering the intended results.
Process Enablement Develop job aids, process guides, FAQs and checklists.
Use AI tools to draft communications and support the rollout of process updates.
Stakeholder Engagement Partner with HR service owners, HR operations teams, HR technology and HR leaders.
Collaborate with external consulting partners supporting the program.
Share findings and progress in team meetings and leadership reviews.
Potential Projects May Include: Building a weekly performance report that compares service results against baseline and business case targets.
Redesigning a job aid or process guide where users are struggling, then tracking whether errors go down after rollout.
Setting up a simple way to collect user and stakeholder feedback on new processes.

Currently enrolled in a master's degree in one of the following fields: Industrial Engineering (preferred)
Systems Engineering or Engineering Management
Operations Management
Information Systems
Business Process Management
Legal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization.

3+ years of full-time professional work experience prior to graduate school.
Consulting experience (management, operations or HR) strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience taking a process improvement from analysis through implementation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to work through ambiguity and build structure when the answer isn't clear.
HR experience is a plus.

Regular use of generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) for research, analysis and drafting, including checking outputs for accuracy.

What You’ll Do...
About Walmart Supply Chain: End-to-End (E2E) Delivery
As part of the E2E Delivery organization, you will contribute to the success of the Walmart Supply Chain! Sam Walton founded our company with the belief that the customer is #1. It is not just a belief, but our way of doing business. With our E2E Delivery Team at the forefront of retail transformation, you can work on a team that is ultimately focused on delighting our customers, saving them both time and money in unexpected ways. As the biggest player in the game, we trust our associates to innovate the future of supply chain & transportation!
About our Teams:
Transportation - The Transportation team implements business processes and improvement strategies to stay current on supply chain and replenishment processes and procedures. As the largest grocer, ensuring our stores have items like food on hand and delivering it to our customers to feed their families is an important role. This is among many ways the team makes a difference in times of need, including helping provide Emergency relief during National Emergencies.
About Our Program:
Each summer, we select the best and brightest to look under the hood of the world’s largest retailer at our Walmart across multiple locations. During the 11-week program, our interns work directly with teams who are changing the way the world shops. This is the beginning of what could be an exciting career with Walmart!
The intern experience includes:
An impactful individual project designed to align to your skillsets and interests
Direct access to leadership across the enterprise
Executive-led speaker sessions with insightful Q&A
Community outreach events
Networking and social events
Learning & development opportunities targeting both hard and soft skills
Deep dives into different areas of our business
Time management and leadership development as a full-time associate
Compensation and housing assistance provided
Roles and Responsibilities:
We are looking for a friendly and proactive Logistics Load Manager Interns to join our team! As a Logistics Load Manager Intern, you will be responsible for assisting in the operation of multiple departments and performing various job-related responsibilities and duties throughout the facility as needed.
How you’ll spend your day as a Load Logistics Manager Intern… Communicate efficiently with customers, suppliers, and associates both verbally and in writing.
Maintain quality and safety standards by training associates on logistics and company policies.
Monitor and manage productivity by preparing, reviewing, and analyzing business reports.
Dispatch drivers while complying with Department of Transportation regulations.
Identify and resolve concerns of associates, customers, and suppliers.
Implement business plans to meet facility goals related to production, quality, and safety.
Why you’re a great fit:  If you can focus on meeting internal and external customer needs.
If you can demonstrate professional judgment by making informed decisions based on data.
If you can align activities with organizational goals and use existing processes to achieve performance objectives.
If you can ensure high-quality transportation operations by adhering to company policies.
If you can form trusting and collaborative relationships across the organization.
If you can show creativity and strength in the face of change and obstacles.
If you can model ethical behavior and enforce compliance with policies.
If you can develop logical and convincing arguments in support of initiatives.
If you can develop plans to achieve organizational goals and improve processes.
Office Environment: You will be placed in one of our Transportation Command Centers.
U.S. Hub Locations: Bentonville, AR and Grove City, OH.
*Location availability is limited based on job profile and business needs.
Desired Majors: Supply Chain Management, Transportation and Logistics, Operations, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, or other relevant majors

Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program currently
